name: 海坊主
hook:
A black shadow,
big as a mountain,
rises from the sea.
lore:
Sailors in old Japan told of
a huge black head rising
from a calm night sea,
just as the waves turned wild.
omen:
Stay calm and hold steady.
If you don't rush, the waves
settle on their own.
act:
Slowly drink
a glass of water
